speaker: caller
text: Hello, am I speaking with Missus Ethel Miller?

speaker: victim
text: Yes, this is Ethel. Who is calling?

speaker: caller
text: This is Officer David Miller from the IRS Tax Crime Unit. Ma'am, a federal arrest warrant has been issued in your name for tax fraud.

speaker: victim
text: Oh my goodness, a warrant? That can't be right.

speaker: caller
text: You must act within 24 hours or officers will come to your home. Do you understand the severity, ma'am?

speaker: victim
text: Well, I, I don't understand, I always pay my taxes.

speaker: caller
text: To cancel the warrant you must pay the outstanding balance immediately. We accept Apple gift cards. Go to the store and buy five cards of five hundred dollars each.

speaker: victim
text: Gift cards? My grandson buys me those at Christmas.

speaker: caller
text: Stay on the line. Do not tell your family or anyone about this call — this is a sensitive federal case.

speaker: victim
text: Oh dear. Hold on, let me find my glasses and my purse.

speaker: caller
text: No ma'am, do not put the phone down. Read me the card numbers and the security code on the back as soon as you have them.

speaker: victim
text: Alright dear, give me just a minute.
